selectFile: Select a file to use the advanced methods.
hint: Methods with their own result: symbolic state spaces, unfolding and reductions. Coverability sets (GRVB and Monotone-Pruning) are in the Graphs tab. They are experimental and each one states what it does not preserve.

symbolic_mdd.name: MDD + Saturation
symbolic_mdd.when: Bounded P/T nets with several tokens per place: exact state count and place bounds without enumerating states. No transition graph, no CTL.

symbolic_bdd.name: BDD (Bryant 1986)
symbolic_bdd.when: 1-safe nets only (weights 1, at most one token per place); the net is refused if a firing violates it.

unfolding_prefix.name: Unfolding prefix (ERV)
unfolding_prefix.when: 1-bounded concurrent nets: reachable markings, dead transitions and deadlock.

structural_rules.name: Structural reductions (Thierry-Mieg)
structural_rules.when: The reduced net is a different net: it only preserves deadlock or safety over the chosen support.

polyhedral_abstraction.name: Polyhedral abstraction
polyhedral_abstraction.when: Reduces the net to (N, E, N′) with linear equations between places. SMT checking is not included.

extendedBlocked: This net has inhibitor arcs or immediate transitions, and these methods only accept plain place/transition nets. Remove those elements to run them.
